annotations.title: Check the dates of a long-term supplier’s declaration

description: Use this when someone asks whether a long-term supplier’s declaration (Langzeit-Lieferantenerklärung, LLE, LTSD) for preferential origin is valid for given dates, how far back it may reach, or whether it covers a given shipment. Checks the three dates of a long-term supplier’s declaration for preferential origin under Art. 62(2) Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2447 (from 23 June 2028: data elements 3.02 and 3.03 of Annex 22-15 as amended by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1183): start at most 12 months before and 6 months after the date of issue, end at most 24 months after the start. Returns valid or the limit broken, the earliest and latest start and the latest end, and, with a delivery date, whether that shipment is covered. Dates only: it never says whether goods have preferential origin. Do not use to judge whether goods have preferential origin or qualify for a preference under an agreement; it checks dates only, not origin.

delivery_date.description: Date of one shipment to check against the period, YYYY-MM-DD

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.
